title: ‘We escaped with only our lives’: Fighting to give birth in war-torn Yemen
keyFacts: When fighting suddenly escalated around Taiz, in southwestern Yemen two months ago, midwife Anisa Fadhl had no time to pack a bag before she fled, leaving behind her home and her clinic. Both were later looted and destroyed.

title: Homes abandoned, harvests failing: Haiti’s farmers rebuild amid violence, hunger and El Niño
keyFacts: Years of insecurity, violence perpetrated by murderous armed gangs and economic instability, combined with displacement, poor agricultural performance and climate shocks, have left millions of Haitians struggling to meet their food needs.
